name: Arataki Itto
description: A loud and boisterous leader of the Arataki Gang, Itto is full of energy and competitive spirit. Despite his reckless tendencies, he has a big heart and fiercely protects those he cares about.

name: Chiori
description: A refined couturier who blends artistry with meticulous craftsmanship. Chiori remains composed and sharp-witted, approaching every task with elegant precision.

name: Gorou
description: A loyal canine-featured general who inspires troops with his unwavering courage. Gorou is dependable and earnest, always supporting his allies with genuine care.

name: Kaedehara Kazuha
description: A wanderer with a poetic soul who finds beauty in fleeting moments. Kazuha approaches conflict with calm reflection, letting the wind guide his sword.

name: Kamisato Ayaka
description: The elegant daughter of the Kamisato Clan, Ayaka devotes herself to both diplomacy and martial grace. Though refined and gentle, she acts decisively when protecting her home.

name: Kamisato Ayato
description: Calm, tactful, and composed, Ayato manages the affairs of the Yashiro Commission with strategic efficiency. He maintains a polite smile while navigating the complex politics of Inazuma.

name: Kirara
description: A diligent delivery specialist with feline traits who treats every package with utmost care. Kirara’s cheerful personality and efficiency make her well-loved across the regions she travels.

name: Kujou Sara
description: A disciplined and loyal general who serves with absolute dedication. Sara upholds her ideals of honor and duty, striking swiftly when threats arise.

name: Kuki Shinobu
description: A calm, competent kunoichi who balances rebellious independence with a deep sense of responsibility. Shinobu works tirelessly to support everyone, often behind the scenes.

name: Raiden Shogun
description: The formidable ruler of Inazuma who seeks eternity through unchanging ideals. Her calm surface conceals deep inner conflict and centuries of contemplation.

name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
description: A brilliant tactician who leads her people with compassion and steady intelligence. Kokomi balances emotional insight with highly refined strategic thinking.

name: Sayu
description: A tiny ninja who constantly seeks new ways to conserve energy. Sayu uses her agility to evade trouble—and chores—while still getting results when it matters.

name: Shikanoin Heizou
description: A sharp detective with keen intuition and an unconventional style. Heizou solves mysteries through insight rather than force, surprising both allies and suspects.

name: Thoma
description: A warm-hearted housekeeper who values reliability and cooperation. Thoma brings people together with his kindness and unwavering sense of duty.

name: Yae Miko
description: The elegant and witty Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine, Yae Miko guides others with playful charm. Her insight is deep, and her motives are often wrapped in mystery.

name: Yoimiya
description: A lively fireworks artist whose creations capture joy and celebration. Yoimiya spreads happiness wherever she goes and treats every moment like a festival.

name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
description: A serene dream-interpreter who navigates the boundary between consciousness and sleep. Mizuki’s gentle demeanor hides a sharp perception of human emotions.
